instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Rank rows by score within each student_id
output: SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY score DESC) FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Dense rank of rows by score
output: SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Row number per student_id ordered by exam_date
output: SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY exam_date) FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Running total of score ordered by exam_date
output: SELECT *, SUM(score) OVER (ORDER BY exam_date) FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Running total of score per student_id
output: SELECT *, SUM(score) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY exam_date) FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Average of score over all rows
output: SELECT *, AVG(score) OVER () FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Previous score value (lag) per student_id
output: SELECT *, LAG(score, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY exam_date) FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Next score value (lead) per student_id
output: SELECT *, LEAD(score, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY exam_date) FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Maximum score per student_id across all rows
output: SELECT *, MAX(score) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id) FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Minimum score per student_id
output: SELECT *, MIN(score) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id) FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Moving average window of 3 rows per student_id
output: SELECT *, AVG(score) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY exam_date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Window frame from first row to current per student_id
output: SELECT *, SUM(score) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY exam_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
First value of score per student_id
output: SELECT *, FIRST_VALUE(score) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY exam_date) FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Last value of score per student_id across full partition
output: SELECT *, LAST_VALUE(score) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY exam_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Percent rank of score
output: SELECT *, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score) FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Cumulative distribution of score
output: SELECT *, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY score) FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Quartile bucket using NTILE
output: SELECT *, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY score) FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Difference of score from its group max
output: SELECT student_id, score, score - MAX(score) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id) AS diff FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Rank of score with ties allowed to skip
output: SELECT student_id, score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Sliding window of total over preceding 5 rows
output: SELECT *, SUM(score) OVER (ORDER BY exam_date ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Running count per student_id
output: SELECT *, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY exam_date) FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Top 2 by score within each student_id using ROW_NUMBER
output: SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY score DESC) rn FROM scores) x WHERE rn <= 2;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Nth value of score within partition
output: SELECT *, NTH_VALUE(score, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY exam_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Expressed ratio of score to group total
output: SELECT student_id, score, score / SUM(score) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id) AS ratio FROM scores;

instruction:
Schema: scores(student_id, exam_date, score)
Window with custom unbounded following frame
output: SELECT *, SUM(score) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY exam_date ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM scores;
